chapter_title: The Case of the Fifth Word
executive_summary: Eighth-grader Leroy 'Encyclopedia' Brown helps his father, Idaville's Police Chief, decode a cryptic note ('Nom Utes Sweden Hurts') clipped to a deceased suspect's will. While adults search dictionary definitions and geography, Encyclopedia realizes the note is torn from a desk calendar sheet ('Nov', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu'). Restoring the clipped letters reveals street locations where stolen jewelry was hidden.
